# Compass artwork and fonts

Only the compass assets and brand marks remain. The earlier historical page
backgrounds, source scans and design studies were removed at the user's request.

## Parchment

`parchment/assets/rose.svg` is a redrawn adaptation of the compass on Jorge de
Aguiar's 1492 chart. `mark.svg` is its compact companion. Geometry is regularized
for Atlas; these are decorative adaptations, not navigational instruments.

Original: Beinecke Rare Book and Manuscript Library, Yale University.
The specific reproduction used as a reference was marked PD-old-100 /
Public Domain Mark 1.0:
https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Jorge_Aguiar_1492_MR.jpg

## Celestial

`celestial/assets/instrument.svg` and `orbit.svg` are original geometric compass
decorations. `mark.svg` retains Atlas's star. An inspected historical reference
was Umar ibn Yusuf's 1291 astrolabe, Met accession 91.1.535a-h:
https://www.metmuseum.org/art/collection/search/444408
The Met marks the object image Public Domain; no photograph is bundled.

## Fonts

The local Cormorant Garamond and Source Sans 3 fonts retain their source hashes
and SIL Open Font Licences in `shared/fonts/`. No remote font or icon service is
introduced by these themes.

Add source and redistribution details here when integrating future backgrounds.
